# Inlines

Strike ~~gone~~ and __strong__ and ***both*** and *star italic* and _underscore italic_.

Entities: &amp; &lt; &copy; &#169; &#x1F600; and a non-breaking&nbsp;space.

Image: ![GitHub favicon](https://github.githubassets.com/favicons/favicon.png "Pic title")

Autolink <https://example.com/a> and <mailto:someone@example.com>.

Bare www.example.com and https://example.com/b and someone@example.com.

Titled [titled](https://example.com/c "The title") and reference [ref link][r1] and [collapsed][] and [shortcut].

Raw HTML <b>bold</b>, <em>em</em>, break<br>after, <span style="color:red">span</span>, <script>alert(1)</script>.

Unicode: café, naïve, 日本語, emoji 🎉, quotes “curly” and ‘single’, en dash 2–5.

[r1]: https://example.com/r1

[collapsed]: https://example.com/collapsed

[shortcut]: https://example.com/shortcut
